title: HiringExecutionReceipt
description: Immutable record of a governed HRIS/ATS execution attempt, produced by the orchestrator ONLY after action authorization (ActionGate) AND runtime assurance both passed. Authorization != execution: a timeout yields OUTCOME_UNKNOWN, never SUCCEEDED. Tracks the implemented domain model ugence_ai_hiring.hiring_decision.execution.HiringExecutionReceipt.

binding_decision_id.description: The binding Employment Decision this action realizes.

binding_authority_id.description: The HUMAN Decision Authority that bound the decision.

action_request_digest.description: SHA-256 over the semantic action payload; binds the receipt to the exact authorized action.

hris_execution_ref.description: HRIS/ATS execution reference returned by the execution port.
